verses.text: Ha in Isaías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Amoz. Ix ch'oxji wil juntzanh tas ix in tz'ib'ejkan tik yuj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén. Ix wil juntzanh tik ayik ayoch heb' winh tik sreyalok Judá: Haton winhaj Uzías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz yet' winhaj Ezequías.
Ex aj satcha'anh yet' ex aj sat lu'um, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ha heb' in chonhab' tik, ix in q'uib'tzitej heb' ayik ix kotoch heb' uninal, haxo ix aji, ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha nok' wakax, yojtak yajal nok' yet' nok' b'uru yojtak nok' b'aj swa yuj mach ay yiko'. Palta haxo in chonhab' Israel, max b'alaj nachajel jab'ok yuj tato wiko'. Ichato malaj spensar, xchi Jehová.

Ex wetchonhab', ix och wal he mul, anhej wal chukal tze k'ulej icha sk'ulejnak heb' ko mam kicham. Te chuk tas tze k'ulej. Ix eyaktejkan Jehová, ix he patikejkanel Dios Haxonhej Ochi, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik. Ix ex meltzaj t'a he patik.
¿Tas yuj tze te pitej he b'a? ¿Tom tze nib'ejnhej tz'ak'jioch yaelal t'a eyib'anh? Ichato lajwinak he jolom, manhxalaj jab'ok yip he niwanil.

Ichato manhxa jab'ok sjakanil he niwanil chi' yuj yaelal, schakot t'a eyok, masanto sk'ek'och t'a schon eyaal. Ay elnak sat, ay tonhej malnak, ay pax wan sk'ab'ati. Malaj pax yanhal tz'ochi, malaj mach tz'ak'anoch jab'ok k'apak t'a sat, malaj jab'ok aceite tz'och t'ay yik spakb'i jab'ok.
Ha he makb'en tik, toxo ix satjieli. Ix ochkan sk'ak'al he chonhab'. Haxo masanil eyawb'en, a wal t'a eyichanh sloji sat yuj heb' ch'ok nacional, kuseltak ix ajkan smasanil.
Ix aktajkan chonhab' Sion, icha tz'aj yaktankan slechpat heb' tanhwum uwa, ma slechpat heb' tanhwum melón, ma icha junok chonhab' oyb'ilk'e yuj heb' ajk'ool yik satel heb'.
Ix to el t'a sk'ol Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, tzonh kan jaywanh onhxo tik, q'uinalok tato maay, lajan am ix aj ko satel icha ajnak chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra.
Ex yajal Jerusalén, lajan ex icha heb' aj Sodoma. E masanil ex anima, lajan ex icha heb' aj Gomorra. Ab'ek wal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal.

Syal Jehová icha tik: Ha jantak he silab' tzeyik'kot t'ayin, malaj tz'och wuuj. Toxo ix yajalax nok' kalnel wuuj, haton nok' snhusjitz'a masanil silab'il. Toxopax ix in tzaktzaj yet' xepual nok' nok' te b'ak'uech. Maxtzak in nib'ejlaj schiq'uil nok' mam wakax, ma schiq'uil nok' mam kalnel, ma nok' yunetak chiwa.
¿Mach ix k'anan juntzanh chi' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzex komon jawi yet' nok' chi' t'a wichanh, tze komon tek'an yamaq'uil in templo?

Manhxo eyik'kot juntzanh silab' chi' t'ayin, manhxalaj tz'och wuuj. Maxtzak scha in k'ol incienso tze nhusu'. Ha juntzanh he q'uinh tzeyak'ochi ayik tz'alji k'een uj, t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' ayik tze molb'an he b'a t'a niwak q'uinh, maxtzak techaj wilani, yujto anhej wal chukal tze k'ulej.
Ha juntzanh he q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj chi' yet' juntzanhxo he q'uinh b'aj tze molb'ej he b'a, chakb'ilxoel wuuj. Maxtzak techaj wilanochi. Toxo ix yajalax wuuj.
Ayik tze mojb'ank'e he k'ab' t'ayin, tzex lesalwi, tzin b'at mikan t'ayex. Wach'chom jantak tzeyutej he lesalwi, palta max wab'laj he lesal chi', yujto milumcham anima ex.
Ha tiknaik, ik'ekel juntzanh chukal chi' t'ayex, tzeyaktankan he k'ulani, tzeyik'anel he b'a t'a skal.

k'ayb'ejek he b'a he k'ulan wach'il. Ha wal tojolal tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool he k'ulani. Kolwajanhek t'a heb' tz'ixtaji, wach' tzeyutej he b'oan yaj heb' unin manhxa smam. Alek syaelal heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Kotanhek, ko b'oek yaj juntzanh tik. Wach'chom te chuklaj eyilji yuj he mul, palta ol ex in sakb'itejkan icha wal k'een sakb'akom. Wach'chom max yal yel he mul icha junok k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak max el yuk'em, palta ol ex in sakb'itejkan icha nok' saksak lana.
Tato tze cha eyab'i, ol he lo sat masanil tas wach' tz'el t'a sat he lu'um tik.
Palta tato hanheja' pit tzeyutej he b'a jun, ol ex cham yuj owal ol wak'kot t'ayex. Ha inton wal Jehová in swala', xchi.

Ex aj Jerusalén, ha t'a pekataxo te tek'an ex. Palta haxo tiknaik, ¿tas yuj icha junok ix ajmul ix, ix ex ajkan t'a yol in sat? Ha t'a peka' chi', a tojolal tze b'eyb'alej, palta haxo tiknaik, milumcham anima ex.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, icha yilji k'een plata eyilji, haxo tiknaik, icha smikal k'een eyilji. Ha t'a yalanhtax chi', icha wino te wach', ichex ta', haxo tiknaik, icha ha ha' ix ex ajkani.

Ha heb' eyajalil, ix te pitb'iel heb', wach' yak'an heb' yet' heb' elk'um. Stzalaj heb' yet' k'een tumin scha' t'a elk'altak. Snib'ej heb' to ay tas siaj t'a heb'. Maxtzak yal syaelal heb' meb'a' manhxa smam heb' yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in ex aj Israel, a in swal icha tik: k'okb'ilxo chi'. Ha ex ajk'ol eyajoch t'ayin, ol in b'o yaj heyet'ok, ol in pak in b'a t'ayex.
Ol wak'och eyaelal, ol in nhustz'a masanil he paltail, ol wik'ankanel masanil he mul ayoch t'a eyib'anh.

Ol wak'anxioch heb' juez te tojol spensar t'a he kal icha t'a pekatax chi' yet' heb' ak'um razón icha yajtaxon t'a sb'ab'elal. Yuj chi' ol yal heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik: Ha jun chonhab' te wach', te k'anab'ajum, xcham heb'.
Yuj in tojolal, ol in kolkanel heb' kajan t'a Sion, haton heb' ol sna sb'a.
Palta haxo heb' te pit, heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' tzin patikaneli, ol satel heb'.
Icha chi' ol aj he q'uixwi, yujto ix laj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a yichtak te' ji yet' t'a skaltak te' awb'en te'.
Icha wal tz'aj sk'ajb'anel xil te' ji chi', icha pax yaj te' awb'en te' manhxa nhab' tzek' t'a yib'anh, icha wal chi' ol ex ajkanok.

Ha heb' te tek'an, icha wal anh ak ol ajkan heb'. Haxo yechel komon Dios ix sb'o heb', icha namix k'ak' ol ajkanok. Junnhej ol aj yoch sk'ak'al heb' yet' yechel chi', manhxa mach ol yal smak'an tupok, xchi Jehová.
